extension.description: Browse and watch YouTube without an account or the official API. Search, channels, playlists and local subscriptions; everything (subscriptions, history) stays on your device. Playback is resolved locally via PluginsGR.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host or distribute any content; it only browses publicly available YouTube pages. No account, no tracking, no data leaves your device except the page requests needed to list and play videos.
extension.news: [B]1.0.0[/B] - Initial release: search, channels (videos/shorts/live/playlists), playlists, local subscriptions with feed, local watch/search history, audio-only mode
